proposal.arity: finite ordered sequence of exact integer (residue,positive-modulus) pairs
proposal.law: Normalize each r modulo m>0. For pairwise compatible constraints (ri-rj) mod gcd(mi,mj)=0, return unique least nonnegative representative x and period L=lcm(mi) such that x mod mi=ri mod mi for every original i; for empty input return x=0,L=1. On inconsistency return the lexicographically earliest original conflicting index pair (i,j) with gcd and nonzero difference mod gcd. Invalid modulus/type is a distinct input failure.
proposal.boundary: No floating approximate clock drift, baud assumptions, UTC leap seconds, MCU register state, sample rate or hardware dispatch; this is an exact integer law only.
